name: Address Beach Resort
blurb: Chic, beachfront serenity with panoramic sea views and private pool suites
description: Experience unparalleled luxury at Address Beach Resort, where contemporary design meets Mediterranean elegance. Our beachfront sanctuary offers pristine white sand beaches, world-class amenities, and breathtaking sunset views.

name: Rixos Premium Alamein
blurb: All-inclusive opulence, gourmet dining, and world-class entertainment
description: A flagship all-inclusive resort offering the pinnacle of luxury with gourmet restaurants, premium entertainment, and exceptional service in an stunning beachfront setting.

name: Casa Cook North Coast
blurb: Boho-luxe lifestyle haven for design lovers and soulful escapists
description: A design-forward retreat combining bohemian aesthetics with luxury comfort, perfect for travelers seeking authentic style and soulful experiences.

name: The G Hotel Seashell
blurb: Glamorous seaside living with a fashion-forward edge
description: Sophisticated beachfront glamour meets contemporary design in this fashion-forward resort offering stylish accommodations and trendy seaside living.

name: JAZ Almaza Beach Resort
blurb: Family-friendly comfort on one of the coast's most pristine stretches
description: Exceptional family resort on pristine beachfront, offering comfort, entertainment, and memorable experiences for travelers of all ages.

blurb: Contemporary, connected, and steps from the region's liveliest marina
description: Modern lifestyle hotel in the heart of Marassi, offering contemporary comfort steps away from the vibrant marina, restaurants, and entertainment.

name: Al Alamein Hotel
blurb: A heritage icon reimagined for modern comfort and timeless style
description: Historic hotel reimagined with modern luxury while preserving its heritage character, offering timeless elegance and contemporary comfort.

name: Address Golf Resort
blurb: For those who pair waves with world-class greens
description: Premier golf resort combining championship greens with beachfront luxury, perfect for golfers seeking the ultimate coastal sporting experience.
